description: Election Commission - Declare that K. T. De Silva as a member of the Karandeniya Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Karandeniya Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes at the local government level, including the declaration of a new member to fill a vacancy created by a member's failure to attend meetings. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authorities elections.
